text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: Retain P3 optional leaf integration. Current GroupData already expresses VarianceCapability and effectsOnly/withVariances; EstimateGroup already prepares admitted persisted estimates and reads selected sample blocks. Reuse these native paths and their identity/provenance contracts if a table consumer emerges; do not create a competing estimate-set loader or make native inference depend on Frame. Deterministic subject/support alignment and prevention of pseudoreplication remain valid. No group-ntab build exists, so this is not a completed implementation or present correctness defect.
